info.title: API.SH: Zillow
info.description: The Zillow API from API.SH: public Zillow data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Every review of a Zillow agent or team, 10 a page: rating, date, reviewer, text, the transaction it was about, sub-ratings (local knowledge, process expertise, responsiveness, negotiation skills), which team member it was for, and the agent's reply. Filter by the service the client got and sort by date or rating; `total` counts the reviews for the chosen filter.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zillow-agent-reviews

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The agent's Zillow profile link (https://www.zillow.com/profile/<screen name>).

parameters.description: The agent's screen name, instead of `url`.

parameters.name: zuid
parameters.description: The agent's `encoded_zuid` (from /zillow/v1/agent), instead of url or screen_name: skips the profile lookup; `total` is then null.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (10 reviews a page).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default newest).

parameters.name: service
parameters.description: Only reviews for this service (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Real estate agents and teams for a city or ZIP from Zillow's agent directory, 16 per page: name, brokerage, rating, review count, sales stats (price range, sales in the last 12 months, sales in the area), Top Agent flag and profile link (`screen_name` works with `/zillow/v1/agent`). Pass `next_page` back as `page` (Zillow shows up to 25 pages). `available_filters` lists every specialty and language key. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zillow-agents

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City and state or ZIP, e.g. `Seattle, WA` or `98103`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-25.

parameters.name: buying
parameters.description: true: agents who help buyers.

parameters.name: selling
parameters.description: true: agents who help sellers.

parameters.name: top_agent
parameters.description: true: Zillow Top Agents only.

parameters.name: specialties

parameters.name: languages
parameters.description: Comma list, e.g. spanish,french (american-sign-language, arabic, bengali, cantonese, farsi, french, german, greek, haitian-creole, hebrew, hindi, hungarian, italian, japanese, korean, mandarin, polish, portuguese, russian, spanish, filipino, thai, turkish, ukrainian, vietnamese).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Zillow home values and market trends
get.description:
The Zillow Home Value Index for a city, ZIP code, neighborhood, county or state: latest typical home value, month and year changes, state, county and national values, median list and sale price, new listings, inventory, monthly home value history, rent index history (with the national one), sale-to-list and share sold above or below list, days to pending, neighborhood values and nearby homes and rentals.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zillow-market

get.description:
Homes for sale, for rent or recently sold on Zillow, from a Zillow search `url` or a `location` with filters: price, beds, baths, living area, year built, lot, days listed, home type, sort, and the filter panel's other filters (keywords, HOA fee, parking, garage, single story, basement, views, pool, air conditioning, waterfront, 55+ communities, 3D tour, open house, listing kinds, pending and pre-foreclosure listings; for rentals pets, in-unit laundry, income-restricted and move-in date). The filters apply with `location`; a `url` keeps its own. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zillow-search

parameters.description: City and state, neighborhood, or 5-digit zip to search when no `url` is given.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: for_sale (default), for_rent or sold. With `location`.

parameters.description: Minimum price (monthly rent for `status=for_rent`).

parameters.name: max_beds

parameters.name: baths
parameters.description: Minimum bathrooms.

parameters.name: max_baths
parameters.description: Maximum bathrooms.

parameters.name: min_sqft
parameters.description: Minimum living area, sq ft.

parameters.name: max_sqft
parameters.description: Maximum living area, sq ft.

parameters.name: min_year

parameters.name: max_year
parameters.description: Latest year built.

parameters.description: Minimum lot size, sq ft.

parameters.name: max_lot
parameters.description: Maximum lot size, sq ft.

parameters.name: days

parameters.name: home_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: house, townhouse, condo, multi_family, apartment, land, manufactured.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), newest, price_desc, price_asc, beds, baths, sqft, lot, zestimate, zestimate_asc, payment_desc, payment_asc.

parameters.name: page

parameters.name: keywords

parameters.name: garage

parameters.name: stories
parameters.description: single: single-story homes only.

parameters.name: basement
parameters.description: finished, unfinished or any: must have such a basement.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Comma-separated views (any of them): city, mountain, park, water.

parameters.name: pool
parameters.description: true: must have a pool.

parameters.name: ac
parameters.description: true: must have air conditioning.

parameters.name: waterfront
parameters.description: true: waterfront homes only.

parameters.name: senior_community
parameters.description: 55+ communities: include (default), exclude or only.

parameters.name: 3d_tour
parameters.description: true: only listings with a 3D tour.

parameters.name: open_house
parameters.description: true: only listings with an upcoming open house.

parameters.name: listing_type
parameters.description: For `status=for_sale`: comma-separated kinds to keep (the others are left out): agent_listed, fsbo (for sale by owner), new_construction, foreclosure, auction, coming_soon.

parameters.name: pending
parameters.description: For `status=for_sale`, true: also include pending and under-contract listings.

parameters.name: pre_foreclosure
parameters.description: For `status=for_sale`, true: also include pre-market foreclosures and pre-foreclosures (not yet on the market).

parameters.name: pets
parameters.description: For `status=for_rent`: comma-separated pets the rental must allow: cats, small_dogs, large_dogs.

parameters.name: laundry
parameters.description: For `status=for_rent`: in_unit (washer and dryer in the unit).

parameters.name: income_restricted
parameters.description: For `status=for_rent`, true: only income-restricted rentals.

parameters.name: move_in_date
parameters.description: For `status=for_rent`: available by this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Homes near a home and the comparable homes Zillow uses for its Zestimate: zpid, link, address, price, Zestimate, rent Zestimate, status, type, beds, baths, living area, lot size, coordinates, last sale and photo; plus nearby cities, neighborhoods and ZIP codes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zillow-similar

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Zillow home link in any form, or the zpid.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A home's Zestimate history: the monthly value series from the home page's value chart (over 1, 5 or 10 years), or the Rent Zestimate, Zestimate change, tax paid, tax assessment (land and structure) or listing-price series, plus the current Zestimate and Rent Zestimate, its sale and listing price history (date, event, price, price per sq ft, change, source, agents) and its tax history (year, tax paid, assessed value and their yearly change).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zillow-zestimate-history

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Zillow home URL (…_zpid/) or the zpid.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Series to return (default home_value: the Zestimate).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Time span of the series (default 10y).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

NWMLS as distributed by MLS GRID

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
